text.card: A red giant 6,902 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.29 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,973 K at its surface.
